mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as lower rates signal accommodative monetary policy that boosts equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined over the past month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is accelerating, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 days due to the dual pressure of higher discount rates and real rate increases, which compress equity valuations.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and accelerating CPIAUCSL fails to predict negative returns in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points over the past month signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regimes, when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month, the 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level (HOUST) above 1600 thousand units signals strong demand for residential construction, which is associated with robust economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST > 1600, the 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both exceed their 12-month moving averages, it indicates strong consumer demand and economic momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In cases where HOUST and RSAFS both exceed their 12-month moving averages, the 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100, the 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% annually signals persistent inflation, which typically leads to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 3.0% (annualized), the 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
